children: AMC priced $2,000 million of 8.875% first‑lien notes due 2031 and $850 million of first‑lien term loans to refinance outstanding 2029 obligations.
Priced $2,000 million aggregate principal of 8.875% first‑lien notes due 2031 in a private Rule 144A/Reg S offering.
Priced $850 million of first‑lien term loans at SOFR + 4.50% with 1.50% OID; New 1L Term Loans expected to mature Oct 5, 2031.
New financing, plus a previously announced $1,120 million 2L term loan, expected to close around Oct 5, 2026 subject to customary conditions.
Proceeds, together with cash on hand, will fund a tender offer and redemptions of AMC’s and Muvico’s 2029 secured notes and repay existing term loans.
Notes and term loans will be senior secured and guaranteed by certain existing and future wholly‑owned subsidiaries including Muvico and Odeon entities.
